idea-plugin.name: Branch in Project View
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the current git branch instead of the path (location string) next to each module / content root in the Project tool window.
  • Branch colored by name: green on main/master, orange otherwise.
  • ↑ / ↓ arrows for commits to push / pull vs origin.
  • An amber ● marker when the working tree has uncommitted changes.
  • Click the branch text (or use the context menu) to switch branch via the native Git popup.
  • The branch popup shows the pull request of any module's repository in the GitHub Pull Requests tool window, switching repository as needed.
In monorepos each module shows the branch of its own repository.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.4.4
  • Show Pull Request in the Tool Window is now available in the branch popup of every GitHub repository of the project. It switches the Pull Requests tool window to that repository and opens the pull request of the current branch, or the repository's list of pull requests if there is none.
0.2.0
  • The branch label now also appears in the Scopes view (and other panes), not only in the Project view.
  • Clicking the branch label opens the checkout popup in those panes too.
0.1.0
  • Initial release.

action.description: Opens the git branches popup for the selected module
